texts: On day 21 of Year 1, Hesper reported to the Council that the cold snap had cost about one and a half vessels of mire-essence.
Hesper reported to the Council that the salt-bloom store held eight weeks of winter supply.
Brindle Coombe reported to the Council that the Northcove production was normal.
Sailsworn reported to the Council that the next new moon was twelve days away.
Sailsworn reported to the Council that the harvest party would have twelve members.
Old Vesh proposed that Coraline Ash join the salt-bloom harvest party.

q1_issues.issue: The unit vessel_of_mire_essence is a coined multi-word compound emitted with no decomposition atom (no (Inheritance vessel_of_mire_essence vessel)), which Compound concepts requires of every compound symbol minted from the surface.

(Measure sk_supply_1 duration 8 week) invents the scale duration: no word in "eight weeks of winter supply" supplies a dimension, so the Measures rule reserves unspecified for that slot, and (Measure e duration n u) is defined for an eventuality's extent, not for an entity.

(Past (BeforeBy now sk_new_moon_1 12 day)) tense-wraps a temporal ordering relation — tense wrapping is licensed for categorical, comparative and Measure atoms — and leaves the speech-anchored now constant inside a past-tense sealed report.
The restrictive "next" of "the next new moon" is silently dropped, widening the claim from that specific upcoming new moon to any new moon.

The possession clause "would have twelve members" is collapsed into (Future (Cardinality sk_party_1 12)) instead of the licensed verbal event with Holder/Theme, and the stated kind "member" is never recorded (no GroupOf sk_party_1 member).

q2_gaps: measure/quantity of-NP ("about one and a half vessels of mire-essence", "eight weeks of winter supply") — the measure of-phrase is named only as an exclusion from Possession, with no positive encoding, leaving both the Measure scale slot and the multi-word unit symbol unlicensed
a predicative statement of group size ("the harvest party would have twelve members") — Cardinality is only ever introduced from a counted-plural NP, never from a "have N members" clause

a mandative / subjunctive that-complement ("proposed that Coraline Ash join the party") — nothing distinguishes its directive force from a declarative that-clause; Directive/Forbid covers imperatives only
an anaphoric ordering modifier on an entity NP ("the next new moon") — next/last is covered only as a time adjunct on a weekday ("next Tuesday"), and Ordinal covers first / nth / last but not "next"

a capitalized adjectival epithet inside a personal name ("Old Vesh") — the casing rule makes the whole capitalized run the name symbol (old_vesh) while the courtesy-title rule derives the symbol from the name alone (vesh), and nothing says which governs an epithet
review.notes: The five-report skeleton is well handled: distinct sk_report_1..5, Experiencer holders with Recipient addressees, sequence-of-tense kept inside each seal, the Northgate-pattern Possession for "the Northcove production" correctly left sealed while its typing and Name project, and the indefinite winter_supply witness correctly kept inside the seal. One side effect of resolving "the salt-bloom harvest party" to sk_party_1 is that the symbol carries two unrelated compound kind atoms (harvest_party and salt_bloom_harvest_party) with no link between them.

issues.reason: Compound concepts mandates decomposition for compound actions, phrasal verbs and modifier_noun kinds -- not for Measure unit symbols, and the prompt's own coined rate unit cent_per_share carries no decomposition atom -- while vessel_of_mire_essence is not a modifier_noun (its last word is not its head), so the objection mistakes the reviewer's own measure-of-NP coverage gap for a parse defect.

duration is a reserved Measure-family scale the instruction set itself uses where no word supplies it ('Sam drove for six hours' -> (Measure sk_drive_1 duration 6 hour)), so it is not the invented open-class dimension the 'never invented / use unspecified' rule bars; stretching it from an eventuality to a stock of supplies is improvisation inside the measure-of-NP gap, and (Measure sk_supply_1 duration 8 week) is true of 'eight weeks of winter supply' and well-typed.

Time anchors 'N units away / from now' on the reserved constant now, and a copular clause with no event witness carries its tense by wrapping the atom the clause yields (Status predicates, the same wrap Comparatives and Measures take), so (Past (BeforeBy now sk_new_moon_1 12 day)) is licensed improvisation whose every atom is true of what Sailsworn reported -- and it is sealed under Theme, so nothing reaches top level.

The half that stands is that no atom records 'next' (a real gap the reviewer also files, since Ordinal covers first/nth/last and 'next Tuesday' covers only a time adjunct); the half that falls is 'widening to any new moon' -- sk_new_moon_1 is a specific witness and (BeforeBy now sk_new_moon_1 12 day) already places it ahead of now, exactly as 'next Tuesday' lets the clause's direction carry the modifier instead of an atom.

Two kinds of clause makes 'have' a verbal predicate and Thematic roles assigns it Holder, so 'would have twelve members' must reify a have eventuality with the counted-plural object as its Theme; collapsing it to (Future (Cardinality sk_party_1 12)) deletes the eventuality the rule requires, hangs Cardinality on a symbol with no GroupOf, and drops the stated kind 'member'.

gaps_confirmed: measure/quantity of-NP ('one and a half vessels of mire-essence', 'eight weeks of winter supply') -- named only as an exclusion from Possession, with no positive encoding for either the Measure scale slot or the multi-word unit symbol

mandative / subjunctive that-complement ('proposed that Coraline Ash join the party') -- nothing marks its directive force apart from a declarative that-clause, and Directive/Forbid is imperative-only
'the next new moon' -- an anaphoric ordering modifier on an entity NP: Ordinal covers first/nth/last but not 'next', and 'next Tuesday' covers only the time-adjunct case

'Old Vesh' -- a capitalized adjectival epithet inside a personal name: the casing rule makes the whole capitalized run the symbol (old_vesh) while the courtesy-title rule derives it from the name alone (vesh), and nothing says which governs
new_gaps: 'On day 21 of Year 1' -- an epoch-relative day-of-year date has no Time term: the vocabulary is Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute and (Day n) elsewhere means day-of-month, so (Day 21) beside (Year 1) is unlicensed improvisation.

A deictic interval inside a reported past complement ('reported that the next new moon was twelve days away') has no report-time anchor: now is speech-anchored, so the sealed content measures the twelve days from the text's present rather than from the day-21 report, and sequence-of-tense is declared surface-mechanical with no device to re-anchor it.
adjudication.defect_summary: For the one confirmed issue the compliant form is the reified possession event inside report 5's Theme seal -- (Member sk_have_1 have) (Holder sk_have_1 sk_party_1) (Theme sk_have_1 sk_members_1) (GroupOf sk_members_1 member) (Cardinality sk_members_1 12) (Future sk_have_1) -- with the party's own typing and genus projecting at top level as they already do.
adjudication.notes: The reviewer's second gap claim is not a gap: 'twelve members' is an ordinary counted-plural object, so the licensed have-event plus GroupOf/Cardinality composes with no new machinery -- which is precisely why the collapse is a defect rather than improvisation. The five-report skeleton, the Northcove Possession correctly left sealed while its typing and Name project, and the stative-transitive Agent on 'held' are all right.
